methods_sentence_followed: In round t the adversary observes the deployed detector f_{t-1} through score queries only, with no gradient access ... The institution either retrains f_t on the labelled outcomes of round t after a labelling delay Delta, or does not retrain at all, which is the frozen detector of Hypothesis 3(a); a round is one labelling delay, because the adversary can respond only to what has been caught and labelled.
protocol: round t: the deployed detector f_{t-1} scores the adversary's round-t records; those records are then labelled (one round = one labelling delay) and fit f_t; the adversary of round t+1 best-responds to f_t; f_t scores the new round-(t+1) records.
